source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Power on and boot in BIOS.
2. Press load default,save and reboot.
3. Boot in BIOS,compare setting should matches SPEC.
4. Change BIOS all/random setting in this function,to non-default  setting.
5. Save and reboot.
6. Boot in BIOS and check your setting still exist.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. The default setting should matches SPEC."
2. No error log happen.
3. Normal reboot ,no hang、crash happen.
4. Check your set still exist.

original_test_intent: Verify CPU Configuration defaults and persistence of approved non-default controls without unexpectedly changing core/thread/NUMA availability, virtualization capability, power/thermal protections, boot behavior or workload assumptions.
original_method: Manually load defaults and compare named CPU fields with SPEC, then apply bounded non-default values, save/reboot or cold boot as required, visually verify persistence and correlate CPU/OS/platform state.
manual_activity: An engineer must interpret CPU firmware controls, operate Setup, load defaults, apply approved values and inspect persistence. Automated topology/virtualization/telemetry checks remain supporting evidence.
required_inputs: Board, CPU model/stepping, BIOS and AGESA identity
Named fields and effects on cores, SMT, NUMA, virtualization, C-states, boost and limits
SPEC defaults and approved non-default values
Warm/cold reset, power/thermal limits, console/BMC recovery
safety_requirements: Never operationalize all/random, disable thermal protection or exceed approved electrical/power limits.
Do not remove required cores/SMT/virtualization capability without workload-owner approval and rollback.
Capture CPU/NUMA/virtualization and hardware-error baselines before defaults.
Stop on boot/training failure, topology mismatch, virtualization loss, hardware error, power/thermal anomaly or management loss.
agent_execution_scope: Collect read-only CPU/core/thread/NUMA enumeration, virtualization flags/capability, power/thermal telemetry, hardware-error logs and BMC health.
Compare approved effects across operator phases without running unapproved stress.
Do not drive BIOS, alter OS CPU policy or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve field/value/default/effect matrix, limits, reset type and recovery.
Perform/capture default-first and non-default persistence phases.
Interpret CPU, virtualization and platform-health evidence and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly rejects agent BIOS execution. No source command exists; OS CPU hotplug, governor, MSR or hypervisor configuration would test another layer and is not equivalent.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Preserve the BIOS method and add read-only topology/capability/telemetry evidence with versions recorded; do not substitute runtime tuning commands.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The default-first lifecycle, null script and 5/20-minute fields are retained; all/random remains non-executable source wording.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Map each firmware field to expected core/thread/NUMA/virtualization/power behavior for the exact CPU stepping, then capture default, persistence and final-state deltas under documented reset conditions and project limits.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact board, BIOS/AGESA, CPU stepping, socket population and approved OS/hypervisor.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS, AGESA, microcode, BMC, OS/kernel/hypervisor and inventory-tool versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform CPU Configuration and AMD/CPU vendor guidance for the exact generation and firmware revision.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces random changes with capability-specific expected effects and platform limits.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; preserves defaults/persistence and adds topology, virtualization and protection evidence.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Field effects, values, expected capabilities, limits, reset and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Presence of a CPU flag does not alone prove hypervisor usability or performance; claims must match the approved validation scope.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve selected availability/virtualization/power controls and omit performance stress. Completion must identify the tested fields and cannot claim all CPU functions or workload performance.
expected_evidence: Platform/CPU/firmware identity, field-effect matrix, approval and recovery
Baseline CPU/NUMA/virtualization, limits, telemetry and error state
Load Default captures plus SPEC and capability comparison
Non-default captures, persistence and expected topology/capability deltas
Final state, logs and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source default-first and persistence phases agree with the criteria. Exact CPU values and effects are readiness inputs, not contradictory requirements.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The CPU configuration lifecycle is clear. Exact platform-bound fields, limits and recovery must gate execution but do not permanently block the case.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Agrees with manual execution and adds CPU-specific capability and safety analysis.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its topology/virtualization/telemetry evidence while correcting classification to MANUAL ONLY.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates firmware acceptance from automated consequence checks and rejects OS runtime-tuning substitution.

review_improvement: Makes core/NUMA/virtualization and protection consequences explicit for the exact CPU stepping rather than treating the page as generic settings.
independent_technical_reasoning: Firmware interpretation, mutation and visual verification are the core operations and require a human. Automated read-only CPU evidence starts after those steps, so MANUAL ONLY applies.
no_automatic_retry: Do not automatically repeat CPU changes, cold boot or recovery after topology, thermal, virtualization or hardware-error anomalies; preserve first evidence and obtain engineer disposition.
